name: What should I check and prepare before hiring a contractor for door frame repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I check and prepare before hiring a contractor for door frame repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling a door frame repair, take clear photos of the damaged area, note whether the door is interior or exterior, and verify if the door slab still latches or swings freely. Check whether the surrounding wall drywall or trim molding is cracked, and look for signs of softness or water stains near the base of the frame. Providing these details helps your contractor determine if the project is a quick hinge and jamb repair or requires structural rough framing work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check if the door latches, note whether it is interior or exterior, inspect nearby drywall and trim for cracks, and check for soft wood so your contractor can assess structural needs.
